title: Professional Certificate Course in Employment Law and Organisational Legal Structure
description: To give the fundamental concepts that underpin UK Employment Law, including the various sources of employment law and their implications.
longDescription: The sources of United Kingdom Employment Law. Types of recognised workers. United Kingdom employment courts. In our course, we'll delve into the fundamental concepts that underpin UK Employment Law, including the various sources of employment law and their implications for employers and employees. You'll also learn about the different types of recognized workers and the rights and protections that apply to each category. Additionally, we'll explore the United Kingdom employment courts and the role they play in enforcing employment law. This course is perfect for those seeking to deepen their knowledge of UK employment law or for those seeking to navigate the complexities of the UK workforce.
